messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northpoint.ai>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: support@northpoint.ai
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in 5xx + throughput drop — NorthPoint production

Monica,

We started seeing a sharp increase in 5xx errors and a significant throughput drop in our inference calls to model 'rwd-large-v2' around 07:45 PDT this morning. Latency for the majority of requests has jumped from ~180ms to >1.2s, and error rate is ~6% on traffic to the predictions endpoint. This is impacting our realtime scoring pipeline — backlog is building in our queues.

Attached: northpoint-raw-error-snippets.txt (sample request/response pairs).

Can you confirm if there are any ongoing rollouts or region issues on your side? If we need to open an urgent bridge, we are ready.

—Ethan
Ethan Cole
Head of Platform 
NorthPoint Analytics

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx + throughput drop — NorthPoint production

On Fri, Apr 9, 2027 at 8:03 AM Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northpoint.ai> wrote:
> Monica,
>
> We started seeing a sharp increase in 5xx errors...

Quick update from the infra side: we see a correlated increase in KV cache evictions and a burst of large-sequence requests from one NorthPoint shard at ~07:44 PDT. Two findings:

1) A fast config rollout to a slightly larger context-length for the 'rwd-large-v2' variant landed ~07:40 PDT and caused increased memory pressure on a subset of workers. Those workers failed fast on allocation paths and surfaced 5xx errors to the gateway.
2) The autoscaler reacted but conservative cooldown combined with limited reserved capacity caused a temporary trough in available workers for the shard.

Immediate recommendations (short-term):
- Roll back the context-length change for the variant that rolled out at 07:40 (if that's permitted by NorthPoint).
- Enable fallback routing to a compatible smaller variant (rwd-medium-v1) for the affected route; this will reduce median latency while we stabilize.
- Manually add two reserved GPU instances to the pool for the next 90 minutes to buy time for a controlled rollback.

I’ve attached a small heap-snapshot.txt with the allocation curve for the affected hosts.

—Karthik Iyer
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northpoint.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx + throughput drop — NorthPoint production

Ethan — thanks for the quick signal and the sample snippets.

Immediate steps we are executing now (customer update):
- We have initiated fallback routing to rwd-medium-v1 for ~15% of traffic to reduce error surface and lower latency.
- Karthik’s team is rolling back the context-length change that correlates with the spike.
- Adding 2 reserved instances to the NorthPoint shard for the next 90 minutes to absorb load while the rollback completes.

Suggested near-term commitments:
- Bridge at 09:00 PDT to walk through telemetry and next steps (invite sent).
- I’ll share a mutual action plan before the bridge and a one-hour postmort on Monday.

Can you confirm if NorthPoint can accept temporary routing to rwd-medium-v1 for the next hour? If you can share 3–5 additional request IDs that show the 5xx, that will speed root-cause validation.

Best,
—Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: david_kim@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: NorthPoint incident — executive summary and ask

Team —

Short executive summary for leadership:
- Incident start: 07:44 PDT on 2027-04-09.
- Impact: elevated 5xx (~6%) and latency ~1.2s for a subset of real-time scoring traffic; backlog observed.
- Root cause (working): rollout of a context-length/config change -> memory pressure -> worker failures; autoscaler cooldown delayed replacement capacity.

Ask: please approve on-call manual credits for NorthPoint should the remediation take >4 hours or if we need to reprocess a backlog. Estimated cost for a short reserve + reprocessing window is attached (estimated-credits.csv). Also ask for an exec liaison (Sean) to be visible for any customer escalation.

I’ll follow up with a proposed postmort timeline and remediation tickets.

—David Kim
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@northpoint.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: NorthPoint — status update and next steps (post-stabilization)

Ethan — final update from our side following the bridge and remediation work.

What we did:
- Rolled back the context-length change that correlated with the memory pressure.
- Enabled fallback routing to rwd-medium-v1 for affected routes; gradually ramped back traffic to rwd-large-v2 after validation.
- Added temporary reserved capacity to remove backlog and protect against autoscaler cooldowns.

Current status:
- Error rate dropped from ~6% to <0.2% for the last 2 hours.
- Median latency for requests routed to rwd-large-v2 is back to ~200ms; fallbacks are <180ms.
- Backlog cleared and reprocessing is in progress; we estimate full catch-up within 3 hours.

Next steps and asks:
- We will run a controlled A/B test of the context-length change in a smaller canary group and validate memory profile before any broad rollout.
- We’ll share a formal postmort and a remediation plan (config gating + autoscaler tuning) by EOD Monday.
- Please confirm whether you want us to submit a formal SLA credit request once the postmort is complete.

Attachments: northpoint-resolution-summary.pdf (high level timeline + action items).

Thanks again for the quick partnership on this. Please reply with confirmation that the service is stable from your side and whether NorthPoint wants a follow-up technical deep-dive next week.

Warmly,
—Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
